req.title: List cookies
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /cookies with a JSON body listing all cookies present on the request.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return a JSON body listing all cookies present on the request when a GET request is made to the /cookies endpoint. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior, a negative test to handle unexpected input, and a boundary test to check edge cases.

tests.name: test_list_cookies_positive
preconditions: The server is running and accessible.
expected: The response JSON body contains an empty cookies dictionary.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/cookies')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json == {"cookies": {}}

tests.name: test_list_cookies_negative
preconditions: The server is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /cookies with an invalid method (e.g., POST).
expected: The response status code is 405 (Method Not Allowed).
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.post('/cookies')
assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_list_cookies_boundary
preconditions: The server is running and accessible.
A cookie is set with a maximum length name and value.
actions: Set a cookie with maximum length name and value.
expected: The response JSON body contains the cookie with the maximum length name and value.
trace: Response JSON contains the maximum length cookie
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
max_length_name = 'a' * 4096
max_length_value = 'b' * 4096
client.set_cookie('localhost', max_length_name, max_length_value)
response = client.get('/cookies')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json['cookies'][max_length_name] == max_length_value
